title: Sending off dismissal not given: challenge by Lavia on Bassey
summary: Sending off dismissal not given: Challenge by Lavia on Bassey. Panel: The challenge by Lavia on Bassey was judged to be low, reckless, and lacked the force and intensity for a red card. The Referee's call of a yellow card for a reckless challenge was supported.
